representations.name: base-b exponent budget polytope
representations.new_information: keeps separately the rough-part exponent, the initial one-digit rounding loss, and the shore-balancing decrement
representations.first_test: set s=floor(K/16) and verify all three budgets leave a K-independent multiplicative tail

representations.name: aggressive half-logarithmic path scaling
representations.new_information: tests whether s near K/2 can reduce the balancing decrement to three units
representations.first_test: use only repeated Bertrand intervals and check whether two incident edge primes still fit below b^(K-3)

representations.name: signed edge-prime kernel of a connected path
representations.new_information: represents every possible signed subrelation by equations z_u+z_v=0 on path edges
representations.first_test: prove connectivity forces the coefficient vector to be zero or a scalar multiple of the full bipartition vector

representations.name: regular bipartite incidence comparator
representations.new_information: tests whether equal local degrees could make all vertices indistinguishable while retaining unequal shore sizes
representations.first_test: compare degree sums on the two shores of a regular bipartite graph

representations.name: valuation-cylinder partition
representations.new_information: freezes exactly what a prime-local rule sees: the full valuation vector on a declared controlled set
representations.first_test: identify a complete positive-density fibre that an o(N) union of fibres cannot delete

representations.name: sparse-prime zero-signature density
representations.new_information: uses a reciprocal-sum bound to retain a positive fraction of integers coprime to all controlled primes
representations.first_test: apply the union bound to prove at least delta N integers have zero signature

representations.name: growing dense-prime comparator
representations.new_information: separates sparse controlled observations from a sieve whose zero fibre itself has zero density
representations.first_test: test the claimed no-go theorem when the controlled set contains all primes up to a growing cutoff

representations.name: independent proportional deletion law
representations.new_information: converts constant tail width into a uniform O(1/K) upper bound for every log-defect weight on the path
representations.first_test: bound every deletion marginal under q(n)<=g_K w_N(n), g_K=o(K), and compute the positive probability that the full path survives

representations.name: adaptive residue-aware comparator
representations.new_information: allows the rule to inspect edge primes, exact cofactors, and global relation context rather than a frozen valuation cylinder
representations.first_test: check whether one path can force such a rule to choose many global owners rather than one vertex

representations.name: transversal packing comparator
representations.new_information: distinguishes a hard single edge from a family with a proved large hitting number
representations.first_test: compute the transversal number of the one-edge path hypergraph before inferring any integral lower bound
